inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL seed insert computes an MD5 digest from a fixed text value while populating a credential row.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored token-digest migration. An UPDATE computes MD5 values for two fixed secrets and preserves NULL for a missing secret; the source schema, identifiers, values, and credential domain are new.

fixture_notes: Tokens 401 and 402 receive deterministic 32-character MD5 digests from distinct secrets; token 403 has no secret and retains a NULL digest after the UPDATE.
determinism_notes: All token IDs, labels, secret values, update expressions, and output ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE token_material (token_id INT PRIMARY KEY, token_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, secret_material VARCHAR(64) NULL, token_digest CHAR(32) NULL)
